title: Synthesis, characterization, antiproliferative activity and DNA binding calculation of substituted-phenyl-terpyridine copper(II) nitrate complexes.
authors: Lin, Kejuan; Jia, Xinjie; Zhang, Xueying; Li, Weikeduo; Wang, Benwei; Wang, Zhiyuan; Xue, Xingyong; Fan, Xiaosu; Ma, Zhen
one_liner_zh: 该文研究铜配合物的合成、抗增殖活性及与DNA的结合，虽含分子对接计算，但对象为小分子-金属配合物与DNA的非特异性结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Ten 4'- (R-phenyl) -2,2': 6', 2' - terpyridine ligands (R = hydrogen (L1), hydroxyl (L2), methoxyl (L3), methylsulfonyl (L4), methyl (L5), phenyl (L6), fluoro (L7), chloro (L8), bromo (L9), and iodo (L10)) were synthesized. The reaction of these ligands with copper(II) nitrate led to complexes 1-10. The characterization of 1-10 was carried out by means of mass spectrometry, elemental analysis, infrared spectroscopy and X-ray single crystal diffraction. Four cell lines including esophageal cancer cell line (Eca-109), human liver cancer cell line (Bel-7402), human breast cancer cell line (SIHa) and human normal liver cell line (HL-7702) were selected to carry out antiproliferation and cytotoxicity experiments in vitro. The results showed that the complexes have strong inhibitory ability on the growth of tumor cells. In order to study the anticancer mechanism of the complexes, the binding mode and binding ability of the complexes with DNA were further determined and discussed with UV-Vis spectroscopy and circular dichroism. The effects of the lowest binding energy and hydrogen bond on the binding were studied using molecular docking calculation.
abstract_zh: 合成了十种4'-(R-苯基)-2,2'：6'，2'-三联吡啶配体（R = 氢（L1）、羟基（L2）、甲氧基（L3）、甲基磺酰基（L4）、甲基（L5）、苯基（L6）、氟（L7）、氯（L8）、溴（L9）和碘（L10））。这些配体与硝酸铜反应生成了配合物1-10。通过质谱、元素分析、红外光谱和X射线单晶衍射对1-10进行了表征。选取四种细胞系，包括食管癌细胞系（Eca-109）、人肝癌细胞系（Bel-7402）、人乳腺癌细胞系（SIHa）和人正常肝细胞系（HL-7702），进行了体外抗增殖和细胞毒性实验。结果表明，这些配合物对肿瘤细胞生长具有强抑制能力。为了研究配合物的抗癌机制，进一步通过紫外-可见光谱和圆二色谱测定并讨论了配合物与DNA的结合模式和结合能力。利用分子对接计算研究了最低结合能和氢键对结合的影响。
